title: Serialize concurrent daemon startup through the project lock
problem: A second daemon can observe a newly created but partially written lock file as stale, remove it, and reach SQLite before the first daemon has finished startup.

acceptanceCriteria.condition: Concurrent startup admits exactly one project owner and the loser reports ERR_DAEMON_ALREADY_RUNNING or an equivalent already-running message.
A lock record that is temporarily unreadable is retried within a bounded interval and is never deleted as stale while its owner may still be starting.
A valid lock whose process is dead remains recoverable without weakening the exclusive-owner invariant.
Windows Node 24, Ubuntu Node 22/24, and macOS Node 24 all pass the daemon concurrency test and the full CI matrix.
